changelog: fix: R taxonomy bars split by group, group-level bars no longer collapse with a long legend; editor lists moved under the chart. (1) 04_taxonomy_* per-sample bars now draw one panel per group side by side (e.g. feed | Reactor) when a grouping is active, in the order the groups first appear in metadata.csv. (2) 04b_taxonomy_group_* used a fixed 6-inch page. With Top-50 the legend wrapped into three columns, took the whole page and ggplot drew the bars at zero width, so Class/Order/Family/Genus came out as a legend over an empty axis. Both bar figures now size the page from the legend's longest name and use a single-column legend, page height growing with the number of taxa. (3) Beta console: Colours, Groups and Samples are drawn in a panel under the chart, side by side, instead of at the bottom of the Customise panel; the Customise panel stays in view while scrolling. Includes 2.9.23: group-level bars sum within each sample before averaging (were 75-96% where a name spans several lineages), Other last and grey, and Save groups takes unticked samples out of the active grouping. Verified: both bar figures rendered with ggplot2 from the U2BI-139 tables at Top-50 (Class, Genus; group bars 100/100); viz_pipeline.R parses; 18 drivers, 584 checks.

previous.changelog: fix: group-level taxonomy bars (04b_taxonomy_group_*) now reach 100%, and Save groups works when you only untick samples. (1) tax_glom groups by the whole lineage, so one family or genus name can be several rows (30 duplicated family names and 81 genus names on U2BI-139). The group bars took mean() straight over those rows, averaging the pieces of a taxon instead of adding them, so bars fell short: Pre-R2 95.7% at Family and 88.4% at Genus, R2 ~84% at Family. viz_pipeline.R now sums per sample first and then averages across the group's samples, so every group bar is exactly 100%. The same per-sample sum is used to rank the Top-N taxa (section 4) and the heatmap rows. Per-sample bars (04_taxonomy_*) were already correct. (2) 'Other' is one segment, stacked last and grey; previously grey went to whichever label sorted last alphabetically (Weizmannia, Synergistaceae) and 'Other' got a real colour. (3) Beta console: unticking samples and pressing Save groups now takes those samples out of the active grouping (left blank in metadata.csv, row kept, other groupings untouched). Before, hiding was not a change to the groups, so Save stayed greyed out — the R1/R2 case. The panel says how many will be taken out before you press it. Verified: group means recomputed from asv_table.csv/taxonomy_table.csv sum to 100% at every rank; viz_pipeline.R parses; 18 drivers, 584 checks.
